command_line:
set -eu
depdir="$PWD/.caper-probe-deps"
if python3 -m pip install --disable-pip-version-check --no-input --no-cache-dir --target "$depdir" "caper==2.2.3" > pip-install.log 2>&1; then
  :
else
  cat pip-install.log
  exit 1
fi
export PATH="$depdir/bin:$PATH"
export PYTHONPATH="$depdir"
{
  echo python
  python3 --version
  echo java
  java -version
  echo caper
  "$depdir/bin/caper" --version
} > caper_probe.txt 2>&1
